title: Sagla Astooti Quuka
intro: Qarwalik rammitle qemmok ugutteeh, yallih fayxil tunkuttube maadi luk. Urriinol uqrat sugeeh, sinni ummatta baysam faxah yan kaxxa miraacah addat culteh sugteeh, ta rooci ellecaboh kaxxa farmo fan seecime. Amaan kee rammitle duuseenak iroh tu sinni silac luk sugeenim, woo waktih addat kaxxa cayla le miraacah foocal soolak, naqoosa luk sugeh yan marah curriyat esseren. Baad isih ken amriik gexxam celta — lee baxsimteh, qaran yabteh, doolat raddeh.
clues: Yi naharsi ayroora bohoy luk sugte — yi celtah tan urritte, fooca fanah bohoy le racmatta sinni miraacih gabat sugte.
Anu leeh addat cattiimeh sugem kee yi finqa gorrisah yan amoytiini daala addat ugte.
Anu garciik tekke qawwalaylak lakal inni baaxok kudeeh, alla baaxol rammitle duuseena akkuk.
Anu too caylale mirac sahlin taama abeynit kee qado farmo luk, yi ummattah amobaxxaaqa esserak fooca fanah gexuh uduureh.
Anu yoo kataytah tan marah kaxxa lee baxiseh, woo lee yi naqboyti inkih yanxuqeh yan wak wagte.
Anu Yallih miracsenta geyuh diini qale feereh, nummah sumaaqah sagaal takke qado astooti yoh tomcowwe.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
